meta.name: File supplier invoices from Gmail to Google Sheets with Gemini and Telegram alerts

name: Extract Gmail invoices to Google Sheets with Gemini AI and Drive backup

nodes.name: Sticky Note — what this template does

parameters.content:
## File supplier invoices from Gmail — read by Gemini AI

**Who it's for** — small businesses, freelancers and bookkeepers who receive supplier invoices by email and still copy the numbers into a spreadsheet by hand.

**How it works**
1. Gmail is watched for unread mails with a PDF attached.
2. The PDF is archived in your Google Drive folder first — you never lose the source document.
3. Gemini reads the text and pulls out supplier, invoice number, dates, net, VAT, total and currency.
4. Anything it cannot read cleanly is parked, and you get a Telegram message instead of a bad row.
5. Duplicates are checked against the sheet itself and stopped.
6. Clean invoices become one row in Google Sheets with a link back to the PDF, the email is marked as read, and Telegram confirms what was filed.

**Setup steps**
1. Connect Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Telegram and Google Gemini (a free API key from Google AI Studio is enough).
2. Create a sheet named **Invoices** with columns: supplier, number, date, due, net, vat, total, currency, pdf.
3. Open **Your settings** and paste your Telegram chat id, the sheet URL and the Drive folder URL.
4. Activate the workflow, then email yourself a PDF invoice to watch it get filed.

## 1 · The invoice arrives on its own

Gmail is watched for unread mails with a PDF attached. Your settings live in one node, and the original PDF is archived in your Drive folder before anything else happens.

## 2 · Gemini reads it

The PDF text goes to Gemini, which returns supplier, number, dates and amounts. The tidy-up step turns them into real numbers and decides whether the read is complete enough to trust.

## 3 · Nothing is written twice

The sheet is read back first. If supplier, number and total already match a row, the invoice is stopped and you are told on Telegram — unreadable PDFs are parked for a human the same way.

## 4 · Filed, linked, confirmed

One clean row per invoice, with a link to the archived PDF. The email is marked as read so it never triggers twice, and Telegram tells you what was filed.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are an expert at reading supplier invoices.
Only extract information that is really in the text.
If you cannot find an attribute, omit it — never guess or invent a value.

attributes.name: supplier
attributes.description: The company that issued the invoice (the seller), not the customer it is addressed to

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number or id exactly as printed, e.g. INV-2041

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued, formatted YYYY-MM-DD

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The payment due date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The amount before tax, digits only

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: The tax or VAT amount, digits only

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The final total to pay, digits only

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD
